addr: 461, 17th Cross Rd, Sector 4, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t: Been buying cakes here for all occasions over the past 2 years, and it’s always a great experience! The cakes are delicious, perfectly balanced (not overly sweet), and come in a wide variety of flavors. …

Loved the paneer roll! It was tasty, fresh, and had the right amount of filling.
The chocolate cakes were also really good — rich, moist, and not too sweet. …

Its a moderate sized place filled with aroma of freshly baked goods, making it cozier for all sorts of groups! We got some pastries, mostly sticking to chocolate and coffee flavoured ones(our personal bias) and they tasted SO GODAMN GOOD!!! …
